performance_description:
The performance follows the same format as my previous appearance: a narrative concert built as a continuous story told through song. Each piece flows into the next with brief spoken transitions creating a storytelling arc rather than a simple sequence of tracks.

I have a complete 90 minute concert ready to perform, built as a cohesive journey. The program can be adjusted to some extent in length or structure to suit the event if needed.
